description: This PHP class defines the EqualsOperator, used for filtering JSON API requests within the SuiteCRM project. It provides methods to generate filter and SQL operators and validate operator values, specifically implementing equality comparison functionality.

classes.name: EqualsOperator
classes.description: Implements an equality filter operator for JSON API filtering, providing methods for returning filter and SQL representations, and validating operator input.

methods.name: toFilterOperator
methods.description: Returns the filter operator string ('eq') for use in JSON API filters.

methods.name: toSqlOperator
methods.description: Returns the SQL equality operator ('=') for use in database queries.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates that the provided operator is a string and adheres to parent class rules.
